description: This file defines the RangedStream class used internally in PDFsharp for creating digital signatures by handling specific ranges of a stream, excluding certain areas for signing purposes.

classes.name: RangedStream
classes.description: A specialized stream class for handling ranges within a stream, used in digital signature creation.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: An internal class representing a range with an offset and length within the stream.

methods.name: RangedStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ranged stream with an original stream and a list of ranges, validating the ranges.

methods.name: get_CanRead
methods.description: Property indicating the stream can be read.

methods.name: get_CanSeek
methods.description: Property indicating seeking is not supported.

methods.name: get_CanWrite
methods.description: Property indicating the stream is not writable.

methods.name: get_Length
methods.description: Returns the total length based on the sum of the ranges.

methods.name: get_Position
methods.description: Gets or sets the current position within the stream, mapped to the ranges.

methods.name: set_Position
methods.description: Sets the position within the stream, adjusting the underlying stream position accordingly.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, optimized for full-range reads or byte-by-byte reading.

methods.name: PerformSkipIfNeeded
methods.description: Skips to the next range if the current position is outside a range.

methods.name: GetNextRange
methods.description: Retrieves the next range after the current stream position.
